text: Figure 8.3: I-Pdu Mapping (Fibex4Multiplatform: IPduMapping) Please note that the attribute pduMaxLength can be used to configure a maxi- mum length which shall be forwarded to the destination module by the PduR, if the length of the received Pdu ( sourceIPdu) exceeds IPduMapping.pduMaxLength. If the length of the received Pdu ( sourceIPdu) does not exceed IPduMapping.pdu- MaxLength or the attribute is not defined, PduR shall forward the length of the received Pdu (sourceIPdu). Example: Pdu A is transmitted on CAN as CAN-FD frame and forwarded by a gateway as ContainerIPdu to another CAN. Pdu A in the transmitting ECU has the following configuration: Pdu.length = 9 bytes. The routing path to route Pdu A as ContainerIPdu to another CAN has the following configuration: sourceIPdu.length = 9 bytes targetIPdu.length = 60 bytes (due to pduMaxLength = 60 bytes). The gateway has no data length check configured. 1. ECU A transmits PDU A within a CAN-L-PDU with a length of 12 byte (9 byte + 3 byte padding). 2. ECU B (gateway) receives the CAN-L-PDU and CanIf forwards 12 byte to the upper layer as received length. 591 of 1928 — AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL — Document ID 63: AUTOSAR_TPS_SystemT emplate
